name: Katharina Weber
learned: Katharina Weber teaches the 10th grade class at Bauhaus Gymnasium. She's been teaching for almost twenty years and values a well-run classroom above almost everything else.
currently: Katharina Weber is trying to keep her 10th grade class focused and on schedule, which is a daily challenge given how talkative some students are.
speech_pattern: Formal, measured, complete sentences. Addresses students properly ('Mr./Ms. ___'). Rarely uses slang or contractions, even outside class.
lifestyle: Katharina Weber goes to bed around 11:00pm after grading a stack of papers with tea in hand, wakes up around 6:00am, and always arrives at school a full hour before first bell to grade, prep the blackboard, and drink a coffee in an empty classroom before the noise starts. She keeps a strict red-pen policy for corrections and takes a brisk walk through the Ville on weekends to clear her head from the week.
